title: Code and data for: Dormancy gene content tracks phylogeny (Ancestry), not seasonal temperature, across 7,327 bacterial species: a pre-registered test
description: Code, dormancy-gene HMM dictionary, analysis tables, model outputs, the frozen pre-registration, deviation log, phenotype calibration, within-species replication and independent audit for the article 'Dormancy gene content of bacterial genomes tracks ancestry, not environmental variability'.
